name: Integrations
description: Data, ERP, CRM, tax and payment connectors.
takeaways: Connectors for data, ERP, CRM, tax and payments
Synced sources copy; remote sources query in place

cards.title: Connectors
cards.body: Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Amazon Redshift, Athena, Databricks, ClickHouse, CockroachDB, Google Sheets, Auth0, Looker, Metabase, Shopify and QuickBooks.

cards.title: Sync model
cards.body: Synced sources are copied on a schedule using cursor columns. Remote sources are queried in place, for example Redshift from a metric's SQL builder.

cards.title: ERPs
cards.body: NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, Zoho Books and Rillet. Xero and QuickBooks receive the tax of invoices as determined by tax configuration.
cards.example: Invoices flow to Xero with tax.

cards.title: CRM and CPQ
cards.body: HubSpot and Salesforce. Salesforce uses an installable package with a default Flow, or your own Flow, plus object mapping.

cards.title: Tax and payments
cards.body: Avalara AvaTax and Anrok for tax; Stripe for payments.
cards.example: Stripe charges the invoice, Avalara taxes it.

cards.title: Model Context Protocol
cards.body: Zenskar publishes an MCP server so AI assistants can work with Zenskar data.
cards.example: Ask an assistant to list tax categories.

edgeCases: Stripe. Not compatible with Managed Payments; each account connects once; match test and live mode to sandbox and production.
Athena. Needs an AWS account, S3 bucket, Lake Formation database and credentials.
BigQuery. May need fully qualified table names in queries.
One tax engine. At most one third-party engine per business entity.
Entity binding. A Stripe connection's entity cannot be changed after saving.

qa.question: Synced vs remote data source?
qa.answer: Synced copies data on a schedule; remote queries in place.

qa.question: Data source vs ERP vs CRM?
qa.answer: Data sources feed usage in, ERPs receive accounting data, CRMs feed deals and customers.

qa.question: Avalara vs Anrok?
qa.answer: Both are third-party tax engines. An entity connects only one.

qa.question: Stripe vs other gateways?
qa.answer: Stripe is the payment gateway with documented sync rules.

qa.question: Zenskar tax engine vs third-party engine?
qa.answer: You maintain rates in the first; the engine does in the second.

qa.question: HubSpot vs Salesforce?
qa.answer: Both are CRM integrations. Salesforce uses an installable package with a default Flow or your own Flow.

qa.question: Import vs export sync?
qa.answer: Import reads from the external system; export pushes to it.

qa.question: Webhook vs integration?
qa.answer: A webhook pushes events to your endpoint. An integration connects a named product.

qa.question: Usage lives in a warehouse?
qa.answer: Connect Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or Postgres.

qa.question: Send invoices to accounting?
qa.answer: Connect the ERP (NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, Zoho Books or Rillet).

qa.question: Create contracts from closed deals?
qa.answer: Use the CRM integration.

qa.question: Let an AI assistant work with Zenskar?
qa.answer: Use the MCP server.

qa.question: Keep a huge table without copying it?
qa.answer: Use a remote source.

qa.question: Stripe sandbox and live?
qa.answer: Match test mode to sandbox and live mode to production.

qa.question: Athena setup?
qa.answer: Needs an AWS account, S3 bucket, Lake Formation database and credentials.

qa.question: BigQuery queries failing?
qa.answer: Use fully qualified table names.

qa.question: Same Stripe account twice?
qa.answer: Not allowed.

qa.question: Pre-existing customers to Stripe?
qa.answer: Bulk CSV import with reference_id.

qa.question: Entity changed after connecting?
qa.answer: Cannot be changed.

qa.question: What controls sync freshness?
qa.answer: Sync frequency and cursor columns on a synced source.

qa.question: Do ERPs receive tax?
qa.answer: Xero and QuickBooks receive the tax determined by tax configuration.
